messages.author: a014794d3d3c49fa
messages.subject: Invariance testing - non-conformable arguments
parts:
Hi there

I am running a multiple group invariance analysis, but when I try to examine two different models (i.e., metric vs scalar ), I get the following error:

"Error in P1.inv %*% t(A) : non-conformable arguments"

This does not happen when I compare the configural model with the metric model, but only when I try to compare models 2 vs 3, and 3 vs 4. This also makes testing for partial invariance impossible.

Does anyone know how I might address this problem and why it happens only from model 2 onwards?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Invariance testing - non-conformable arguments
parts: "Error in P1.inv %*% t(A) : non-conformable arguments"
I haven't seen this error before.  Could you post your model syntax and lavaan call that led to this error?

messages.author: a014794d3d3c49fa
messages.subject: Re: Invariance testing - non-conformable arguments
parts:
Hi 

This is the relevant syntax for the models, and the call that gave the error:

MANIP_mod_2 <- cfa.mi(MANIP, data = WRISC, m=5, miPackage="mice", chi="all", seed=12345, estimator = "WLSMV", group = "Gender", group.equal=c("loadings")) 

MANIP_mod_3 <- cfa.mi(MANIP, data = WRISC, m=5, miPackage="mice", chi="all", seed=12345, estimator = "WLSMV", group = "Gender", group.equal=c("loadings", "intercepts")) 

anova(MANIP_mod_2, MANIP_mod_3)
